concepts.name: inference
concepts.definition: Using learned parameters to calculate an output for new input.
concepts.reason: A trained classifier is useful only when it can process a new case.
concepts.mechanism: Run the new inputs through the fixed weighted calculation.
concepts.boundary: Inference normally uses parameters without updating them.
concepts.misconception: Inference is not another name for training.
concepts.expectedAbility: Classify an operation as training or inference.
